description: This file defines a composable UI component for a toggle button with text labels and an icon, including preview functions for UI visualization, and internal layout logic. It is part of a design system for an Android app using Jetpack Compose.

classes.name: NiaViewToggleDefaults
classes.description: Holds default configurations for the view toggle button, including padding values.

methods.name: NiaViewToggleButton
methods.description: Main composable for a toggle button with customizable labels and icon, handling expanded/collapsed states.

methods.name: NiaViewToggleButtonContent
methods.description: Internal layout for arranging label and trailing icon within the toggle button.

methods.name: ViewTogglePreviewExpanded
methods.description: Preview function demonstrating the toggle button in expanded state within the app theme.

methods.name: ViewTogglePreviewCompact
methods.description: Preview function demonstrating the toggle button in compact state within the app theme.
